text:
sam: Heads-up — product asked for a 'continuous batching' dashboard covering batch-size distribution, queue wait times, and saturation by pool. Need runtime + infra inputs on metric names/labels we can depend on. Who can own the metric contract?

maria: I can start from runtime side. We already emit a few things but they're adhoc. Proposal: a histogram for wait time and a histogram for batch_size. Key labels: pool, model_family, shard, priority. Avoid full model name (cardinality).

jon: From infra: we need stable label sets and cardinality caps. model_family OK if it's limited to ~20 families. Also request a queue_length gauge per pool plus a saturation ratio gauge (in_use / capacity).

kai: +1 on saturation_ratio. For dashboards we want: heatmap of batch_size distribution, wait_time percentiles, and a per-pool saturation alert panel. Also need a backend-friendly naming convention (redwood_ prefix).

maria: draft metrics (names):
```
# histograms
redwood_batch_wait_seconds_bucket{pool,model_family,shard,priority}
redwood_batch_size_bucket{pool,model_family,shard,priority}
# counters / gauges
redwood_batching_batches_total{pool,model_family,shard}
redwood_batching_requests_queued{pool,model_family,shard}
redwood_queue_length{pool}
redwood_saturation_ratio{pool}
redwood_kvcache_hits_total{pool,model_family}
```
I can emit these from runtime. Buckets for wait time need to capture sub-ms up to seconds. Suggest buckets: [0.0005,0.001,0.0025,0.005,0.01,0.025,0.05,0.1,0.25,0.5,1,2.5,5]. Batch size buckets: [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128].

leah: Product asks for per-customer rollups (to see heavy tenants). Are we ok adding customer_id label? Security/privacy will want that scoped. Maybe emit tenant hashes or use a cardinality-limited `customer_bucket` (low/med/high) instead of free-form id.

jon: We cannot have unbounded customer_id in metric labels. Option A: emit `customer_tier` or `customer_bucket` label from application logic (low/med/high) or Option B: provide a separate tracing/log export with tenant id. For dashboards, metric-level aggregation by `customer_tier` should suffice for initial visibility.

sam: Good catch. So keep metrics low-cardinality. We'll ask product to accept `customer_tier` for dashboard.

kai: Alerts / SLIs: suggest p99(redwood_batch_wait_seconds) < 0.05s per pool, and saturation_ratio > 0.8 for 5m should fire a paging alert. Also panel to show p50/p95/p99. For PromQL we can compute p99 from histogram: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_batch_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool))`.

maria: Implementation notes: runtime will emit raw histogram buckets at 1s scrape. We need agreement on labels: pool, model_family, shard, priority, customer_tier. I'll add `queue_reason` label for queued-on-cold-start vs normal queuing? Keep optional.

jon: Infra will add a scrape job, relabel to drop shard if shard cardinality gets high for cross-tenant scraping. We'll also configure recording rules for percentiles to reduce dashboard load. Eg recording rules: `redwood_batch_wait_p50`, `p95`, `p99` computed from bucket sums.

sam: Can you draft the recording rules and a Grafana panel wireframe? Nothing fancy — just panel names and queries.

jon: Will do. Draft recording rule example: 
```
- record: redwood_batch_wait_p99
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_batch_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool))
```
And we will precompute p50/p95/p99 per pool and model_family.

maria: One implementation caveat: when we route to fallback models we may change model_family label. Runtime will ensure fallback sets `model_family=fallback` so dashboards show graceful degradation.

leah: Timeline: product wants an initial dashboard for the next sprint review (2 weeks). Is that realistic?

maria: Runtime side — can land metric emission in ~4 working days for one pool (tests + flags).

jon: Infra side — implement scrape + recording rules in ~3 days once metrics are emitted. Grafana panels another 1-2 days. So 2 weeks is tight but doable if we prioritise one canonical pool first.

sam: OK action items:
- maria: PR to emit metrics (one pool) with suggested buckets/labels by EOD Thu.
- jon: recording rules + scrape job review + initial Grafana dashboard by next Tue.
- kai: design simple panel wireframe + alert thresholds + SLI definitions.
- leah: confirm `customer_tier` approach with security/product and share mapping.

maria: I'll include a small testbench output snippet in the PR (script that simulates batch arrivals). Example run: `./scripts/emit_fake_batches --pool=alpha --rate=500/s` to exercise buckets.

telemetry-bot: Note saved: task created #CI-4321 (emit batching metrics) assigned to maria, due 4d. :white_check_mark:

sam: Sweet. If anyone has objections to metric names/labels speak up now. Otherwise we'll lock contract and proceed. :eyes:
